svg.aria-label: How I approach engineering. Module and service boundaries follow domain ownership, consistency and deployment needs. Define transactions, retries and event delivery guarantees. Measure throughput, tail latency and resources under documented workloads. A high bar for code quality through automated tests, static analysis, code review and documented tradeoffs.
svg.title: How I approach engineering. Module and service boundaries follow domain ownership, consistency and deployment needs. Define transactions, retries and event delivery guarantees. Measure throughput, tail latency and resources under documented workloads. A high bar for code quality through automated tests, static analysis, code review and documented tradeoffs.
svg.text: I choose module and service boundaries around
domain ownership, consistency, and deployment needs.
I define transaction boundaries, retry behavior,
and event delivery guarantees before implementation.
I measure throughput, tail latency, and resource use
under documented workloads and resource limits.
A high bar for code quality
I use automated tests, static analysis, and code review.
I document tradeoffs so others can examine the decisions.
